osType.title: OS Type
osType.description: OSType is the operating system of the Device

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: Int Match
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: IntMatch is a reusable matcher for signed integer-valued request fields, including fields whose value can be -1 when unknown.

quality.title: Estimate Quality
quality.description: EstimateQuality is whether the EstimatedInputTokens field accounted for the entire input of the request

requireComplete.description: RequireComplete only permits the estimate when Octelium accounted for the entire textual input. It prevents PARTIAL and UNAVAILABLE estimates from being treated as a reliable input-size policy signal.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Operation is the normalized inference operation of the request

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: Protocol is the inference API protocol served by the Service.

addressType.title: Address Type
addressType.description: AddressType is the type of the requested destination address

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Mode is the application-layer protocol understood by the proxy implementing the Service

aal.title: AAL
aal.description: AAL is the authenticator assurance level (AAL) of the authentication as defined by NIST SP 800-63B

type.title: Type

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: String Match
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: StringMatch is a reusable matcher for string-valued request fields. The server translates the selected variant into the corresponding CEL string operation.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.title: U Int Match
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.Conditio.description: UIntMatch is a reusable matcher for unsigned integer-valued request fields. It is suitable for both uint32 and uint64 RequestContext fields.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the type of the User

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
